[[Bortak's Bone Claw]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Bortak Bonesmelter]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[Death Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Bone Spiral Rod]] from crafter [[Sheco]].

This item cannot otherwise be replicated, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Hale and Hearty" and "Aptitude not Attitude".
